card.name: Weight and concentration units in dosing
card.fires_on: The unit word that finishes a weight or concentration measure, such as kg, lb, lbs, mL or the L in mg/dL. It appears in dosing tables and kidney-function formulas.

modes.label: Body weight units
modes.description: Kilograms or pounds named in weight-based dosing tables or pediatric weight ranges.

modes.description: The final letter or unit of a per-volume measure, such as dL, 100 mL or mol/L, in lab values and formulas.
